prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity north-star mockup for a mobile-first wedding invitation webpage, portrait phone canvas
Primary request: Design composition option C for the same luxury digital wedding invitation world. This must unmistakably read as an interactive scrolling mobile website, not a poster. Recompose it as a jeweler's specimen cabinet opened for one evening: the invitation begins with a narrow black-cherry lacquer panel and oversized vertical couple names, then a hinged brass medallion reveals a luminous pearl interior where each section is framed as one precious keepsake—not separate generic cards. A circular portrait locket, engraved venue plate, and RSVP seal align along a sweeping diagonal rather than a centered stack.
Scene/backdrop: full-bleed interface; no device mockup, no hands, no environmental background
Subject: demo wedding invitation for AMARA & JULIAN, 18 OCTOBER 2026, guest ELENA MARLOWE, venue The Glasshouse Garden
Style/medium: exceptionally polished web UI comp, heirloom jewelry-case and trousseau album material language, contemporary editorial luxury, tactile but disciplined
Composition/framing: 9:16 portrait; first viewport uses a bold 35/65 split with a lacquer title spine on the left and an opening vellum leaf on the right; a large brass seal overlaps the split; below, one diagonal line connects a portrait locket, four countdown numerals, event schedule, venue engraving, and a large final RSVP seal; no conventional navigation bar
Lighting/mood: intimate evening light, gleaming metal accents, soft illuminated vellum, dramatic but readable
Color palette: deep oxblood, black cherry, luminous pearl blush, muted mauve shadows, antique champagne brass; no terracotta
Materials/textures: polished lacquer, woven moiré silk, deckled translucent vellum, engraved brass, fine botanical blind embossing
Text (verbatim): "AMARA & JULIAN" "DEAR ELENA MARLOWE" "18 OCTOBER 2026" "OPEN OUR EVENING" "THE GLASSHOUSE GARDEN" "RSVP"
Constraints: mobile web UI; strong readable hierarchy; one diagonal story line; interface looks implementable in HTML/CSS; no invented commercial claims
Avoid: generic cream wedding template, rustic florals, rose-gold gradients, glassmorphism, floating rounded cards, bento grid, dashboard layout, device frame, hands, watermark, logo
